sloka: यद् इदम् ते क्षमम् राजन् गमिष्यामि यथा आगतम् ।मिथ्या प्रतिज्ञः काकुत्स्थ सुखी भव सु हृद् वृतः ॥१-२१-३॥
transliteration: yad idam te kṣamam rājan gamiṣyāmi yathā āgatam ।mithyā pratijñaḥ kākutstha sukhī bhava su hṛd vṛtaḥ ॥1-21-3॥

translations.english: O king, if this act of yours is appropriate to you, I will go back (to the places) where from I came. O scion of the race of kakutstha, you have proved false to your promise. Live happily with your relatives".
translations.hindi: मेरे पास जो बड़ी सेना है, उसको साथ लेकर मैं उन राक्तसों से लडूगा
